gloss: Warm Biz; winter energy-saving dress campaign

definitions.gloss: Warm Biz; winter energy-saving dress campaign
definitions.explanation: A Japanese government-led campaign encouraging warm, layered clothing in winter so that office heating can be set lower to save energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ウォームビズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
ウォームビズ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}{温度|おんど}→設定温度：23470_setteiondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: We lowered the heating temperature as part of Warm Biz.

examples.japanese: ウォームビズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: As part of Warm Biz, employees work wearing sweaters.

notes:
A winter counterpart to ⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧ (Cool Biz), promoted by the Japanese government from 2005 to reduce heating energy use. Workers wear warmer clothes so offices can keep the thermostat lower (around 20°C).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウォームビズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to carry out Warm Biz
- ウォームビズ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: the Warm Biz period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧: Cool Biz — the summer version, encouraging light dress so cooling can be reduced
